prompt_template:
You are a memory extraction module.
Current known facts about {name}:
{facts_string}

Recent conversation history:
{conversation_history}

Extract any NEW, concrete information worth remembering (preferences, routines, relationships, intentions). 
Make sure the information is useful.
If it contains information about someone else, only store it if you have their name.
Be short and concise. Do not repeat existing facts.

IF NO NEW INFORMATION IS FOUND, RETURN AN EMPTY STRING.
